description: Cost of one clip from the VidFare calculator. Credit-plan rows use plan price ÷ credits × credits per clip, then the percent of credits used. API rows are billed seconds times the stated dollars per second. A length, resolution, audio value, or input the vendor page does not state is returned without a price.

apply_deals.description: When true, apply today's credit-plan deals the way the calculator toggle does. Defaults to false.

audio.description: with or without audio. on and off are accepted. Omit to leave audio unset.

input.description: Input mode: t2v, i2v, ref2v, v2v, extend, or lip-sync. Omit to leave input unset.

model.description: Model slug, such as wan-3-0 or kling-3-0, or the model name.

plan.description: Credit-plan id, such as hf-starter. Optional.

provider.description: Platform name, such as fal, Higgsfield, Krea, or Magnific. A credit-plan platform selects that platform's first plan, the same way the calculator does.

resolution.description: Resolution such as 480p, 720p, 1080p, or 4K. Use 'not listed' when the vendor page does not list one.

seconds.description: Clip length in whole seconds, at least 1.

used.description: Percent of plan credits actually used, from 1 to 100. Defaults to 100.

window_seconds.description: Seconds made during an unlimited window. Defaults to 60. Used only for the break-even note, which is not $0 per second.

name: estimate_cost
title: Estimate clip cost
